plugins.description: Typebar (formerly SuperDocs), the document harness for your AI: edit, draft, search, summarize and export styled documents (.docx / PDF / HTML / Markdown / plain text) via the Typebar MCP server. Single install bundles 38 MCP tools, 4 user-invocable workflow prompts and a skill that auto-loads when document work is requested.
